storage: Airtight steel, glass or plastic jar at room temperature, away from damp: up to 6 months after opening. A few dried red chillies or bay leaves in the jar help keep weevils away; in humid monsoon months, keep large stock in the fridge. Soaked dal: use the same day, or keep covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Ground chilla batter keeps 1–2 days in the fridge.
substitutes: Moong chilka (split green moong with skin)

usedIn.raw: 50 g dry (¼ cup; about 100–110 g after soaking)
